share-rcb-1-3.label: Share of RCB batting runs from positions 1–3, 2025–2026
share-rcb-1-3.dataset: CricField warehouse: deliveries ⨝ innings ⨝ matches ⨝ players (Cricsheet, IPL 2025–2026)
share-rcb-1-3.query: WITH appear AS ( SELECT d.innings_id, d.batter_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.batter_id UNION ALL SELECT d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id), firsts AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, MIN(first) first FROM appear GROUP BY innings_id, pid), pos AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY innings_id ORDER BY first, pid) position FROM firsts) SELECT CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) THEN 'rcb' ELSE 'league' END side, CASE WHEN pos.position <= 3 THEN '1–3' WHEN pos.position <= 5 THEN '4–5' WHEN pos.position <= 8 THEN '6–8' ELSE '9–11' END band, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN pos ON pos.innings_id = d.innings_id AND pos.pid = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2026 GROUP BY side, band

bowlers-rcb.label: Bowlers used per innings by RCB, 2025–2026
bowlers-rcb.dataset: CricField warehouse: deliveries ⨝ innings ⨝ matches ⨝ players (Cricsheet, IPL 2025–2026)
bowlers-rcb.query: SELECT CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) THEN 'rcb' ELSE 'league' END side, AVG(nb) bowlers, COUNT(*) inns, AVG(top5) top5share FROM (SELECT d.innings_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) nb, (SELECT SUM(b) FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (x.is_wide = 0 AND x.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) b FROM deliveries x WHERE x.innings_id = d.innings_id GROUP BY x.bowler_id ORDER BY b DESC LIMIT 5)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) top5 FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id) q JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = q.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2026 GROUP BY side

bowlers-league.query: SELECT CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) THEN 'rcb' ELSE 'league' END side, AVG(nb) bowlers, COUNT(*) inns, AVG(top5) top5share FROM (SELECT d.innings_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) nb, (SELECT SUM(b) FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (x.is_wide = 0 AND x.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) b FROM deliveries x WHERE x.innings_id = d.innings_id GROUP BY x.bowler_id ORDER BY b DESC LIMIT 5)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) top5 FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id) q JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = q.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2026 GROUP BY side

dual-count.dataset: CricField warehouse: deliveries ⨝ innings ⨝ matches ⨝ players (Cricsheet, IPL 2025–2026)
dual-count.query: WITH bat AS (SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, d.batter_id pid, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) faced FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2026 AND i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) GROUP BY year, pid), bowl AS (SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, d.bowler_id pid, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bowled FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2026 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) GROUP BY year, pid), ids AS (SELECT year, pid FROM bat UNION SELECT year, pid FROM bowl) SELECT ids.year, p.name, COALESCE(bat.runs, 0) runs, COALESCE(bat.faced, 0) faced, COALESCE(bowl.bowled, 0) bowled FROM ids JOIN players p ON p.player_id = ids.pid LEFT JOIN bat ON bat.year = ids.year AND bat.pid = ids.pid LEFT JOIN bowl ON bowl.year = ids.year AND bowl.pid = ids.pid

validation.method: player-level runs sum to the team's batting runs

runs-by-position.label: Share of batting runs by position, 2025–2026: RCB vs rest of IPL
runs-by-position.dataset: CricField warehouse: deliveries ⨝ innings ⨝ matches ⨝ players (Cricsheet, IPL 2025–2026)
runs-by-position.filters: Regulation innings 2025–2026; position = order of first appearance; 'league' excludes RCB
runs-by-position.query: WITH appear AS ( SELECT d.innings_id, d.batter_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.batter_id UNION ALL SELECT d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id), firsts AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, MIN(first) first FROM appear GROUP BY innings_id, pid), pos AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY innings_id ORDER BY first, pid) position FROM firsts) SELECT CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) THEN 'rcb' ELSE 'league' END side, CASE WHEN pos.position <= 3 THEN '1–3' WHEN pos.position <= 5 THEN '4–5' WHEN pos.position <= 8 THEN '6–8' ELSE '9–11' END band, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN pos ON pos.innings_id = d.innings_id AND pos.pid = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2026 GROUP BY side, band
